subject: gk
question: Which of the following is NOT the correct match?

options.text: The acid present in tomato – Formic acid
The acid present in orange – citric acid
The acid present in grapes – Tartaric acid
The acid present in rancid butter – Butyric acid

solution:
The correct answer is __**The acid present in tomatoes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Oxalic acid is a chemical compound that occurs naturally in almost every plant to some degree, including fruit, vegetable and grain plants. 
 
• Tomato contains more than 10 types of acids such as citric acid, malic acid, ascorbic acid, oxalic acid etc. 
 
• The oxalic acid content of tomatoes is about 50 mg per 100 g serving. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
